steps.code:
# Collect all incomplete tasks assigned to jes.mill@gmail.com from all projects
projects = apis.todoist.show_projects(access_token=login_result['access_token'])
all_tasks = []
for proj in projects:
    result = apis.todoist.show_tasks(project_id=proj['project_id'], access_token=login_result['access_token'], assignee_email='jes.mill@gmail.com', is_completed=False)
    # Collect from no_section_tasks
    for t in result.get('no_section_tasks', []):
        t['project_id'] = proj['project_id']
        all_tasks.append(t)
    # Collect from sections
    for section in result.get('sections', []):
        for t in section.get('tasks', []):
            t['project_id'] = proj['project_id']
            all_tasks.append(t)
print("Total tasks:", len(all_tasks))
for t in all_tasks:
    print(f"Project {t['project_id']} Task {t['task_id']}: {t['title']} (assignee_id={t['assignee_id']})")
